notes:
Summary: High-priority DoD-adjacent coastal command; strong requirement for air-gapped private inference. Preference for full on-prem Redwood Private with customer-managed control plane.

Discovery highlights:
- Met with CTO (Lt. Col. A. Reyes) + Head of InfoSec (M. Alvarez) 2025-10-22 (Fireflies ff_2025-10-22_1792).
- Environment: classified enclave (sensitivity level IL4) with no egress. Install must be FIPS-validated, STIG-compatible, and able to integrate with existing HSMs.
- Workloads: operational chat for watchfloor (low-latency, short-turn dialogue), searchable technical manuals (doc-search), automated incident summarization for shift logs, and reranking for sensor telemetry triage.
- SLOs: p95 latency target for chat <300ms for 16k-context local models; embedding batch throughput target 25k vectors/hour for nightly ingestion.
- Model policy: only approved/open weights allowed; no outbound model downloads at runtime. Will accept vendor-provided signed model bundles that pass checksum and signature verification.
- Ops constraints: no managed control-plane out of band unless via customer-managed gateway; upgrades must be staged via physical media or secure jumpbox.
- Reliability: must support local fallback to a smaller quantized model when main pool offline.

Technical notes / POC plan:
- Proposed POC: 6-week on-prem pilot in isolated rack with 4x A100-equivalent nodes + FIPS HSM. Phase 1: install + security hardening + smoke tests (2 weeks). Phase 2: workload tuning (batching, KV caching) + latency measurements (2 weeks). Phase 3: acceptance tests + ATO evidence (2 weeks).
- SE ask: provide detailed install playbook, STIG mapping doc, and BOM with part numbers for preferred partner vendors. Also need guidance on offline model signing process.
- Security ask: Include threat model, supply-chain attestation, and rollback plan for offline upgrades. CISO asked: "How do we verify model provenance without outbound telemetry?"

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Budget: constrained but predictable; procurement prefers capital spend for dedicated racks. Estimated ARR band discussed $500k–$2M depending on SLA and managed services add-ons.
- Procurement timeline: vendor shortlist and legal review in Nov; ATO kick-off targeted early Dec; procurement sign-off expected Jan 2026.
